items.quote: Der Erstbeitrag wird zum Versicherungsbeginn per Lastschrift eingezogen.
items.computation: The letter ties the first premium collection to the insurance start date, printed as 'Versicherungsbeginn 01.10.2026, 00:00 Uhr'. No separate due date is given for the debit itself, so the due date equals the stated Versicherungsbeginn, 2026-10-01.

warnings: This is a policy confirmation (Versicherungsschein), not a bill demanding immediate payment; the printed IBAN DE78 3705 0198 0001 2345 00 is only for the automatic direct debit already authorised, so no action or transfer is needed unless the direct debit fails.

The contract auto-renews for another year unless cancelled in Textform at least three months before the end of the running insurance year (30.09.2027), i.e. by 2027-06-30 for this first term — mark this date so the renewal isn't missed if cancellation is wanted.
